column1: #Software_Description: ChrTracer3 software was developed for analysis of raw DNA labeled images. As an input
column2: it takes an.xlsx table containing information and folder names of the DNA experiment. As an output
column3: it returns tab delimited.txt files with drift-corrected x
column5: z positions for all labeled barcodes. These can be used directly to calculate the nm scale distances between all pairs of labeled loci. The current version of the software as of this writing is ChrTracer3.

column1: #Description:  Imaging of Axin2 locus in 2 cell lines labelled as LCLA and LCLC. Publication:  10.1038/s41467-022-29625-6. Probes were designed in 2kb intervals
column2: for this experiment we combined 4 readouts to achieve 8 kb resolution. Readout sequences can be found in https://github.com/BoettigerLab/ORCA-public

column1: #Brightness: The signal intensity of the brightest pixel within a bright Spot (i.e. local maximum).
